tasks.short: Consult scientists on experiments and analytical models

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual experiment requirements, analytical-model assumptions, prior analyses and the questions for other scientists in engineering document control (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: actual experiment/model question and existing analyses
actual controlled model and experiment references
outputs: engineer-checked actual consultation source set and unresolved model/parameter questions

steps.what: Consult other scientists to determine actual parameters of experimentation or suitability of analytical models, examining assumptions and disagreements
inputs: engineer-checked actual consultation source set and unresolved model/parameter questions
actual scientists' analyses and responses
outputs: actual agreed scientific conclusions, parameter decisions and unresolved suitability questions

steps.what: Capture actual agreed parameter/model decisions and unresolved questions in the existing development record and check the complete entry and destination
inputs: actual agreed scientific conclusions, parameter decisions and unresolved suitability questions
actual project/model revision identifiers
outputs: exact checked actual consultation decision record and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked consultation decision record in its intended internal development revision
inputs: exact checked actual consultation decision record and internal destination

tasks.design: Configure native project/model source links and fixed development-revision context in {OPS_SYSTEM}, engineering document control. The engineer and scientists make actual scientific decisions, then the engineer captures/checks only those decisions before saving; no model determines experimental parameters or model suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated scientific-source navigation and revision identifiers add handling around actual consultation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project/model references can retain actual controlled context.
tasks.still_hard: Analytical validity, parameter choice and scientific disagreement require the scientists.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when model assumptions do not represent the actual experiment.

ambition.what: Reduce source/context handling around actual recorded consultation.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4 with engineering document and research governance owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native engineering source/revision links can reduce navigation while scientific parameter and model-suitability decisions remain expert work.

assumptions: This is actual consultation with an existing development decision record, not an added meeting report. Research owners supply actual analyses; scientists produce conclusions in s2 and the engineer captures/checks them in s3.

Reuse actual references and fixed revision identity only. Missing analyses, disputed conclusions or unknown parameters stay unresolved; no structured decision feed or generated scientific conclusion is assumed.

Native configuration first; equivalent existing links remove the gain. Shares 25/65/9/1 are unmeasured active effort; gross saving 7.5 + 0.9 = 8.4 minus 1.5 hours of context/link upkeep leaves 6.9 net.
Negligible save is fully retained. Final record checking is ordinary capture; edits invalidate the gate. No experiment, model execution or operating change is silently proposed.
unknowns: Actual consultation record and existing model/source navigation
research_questions: Measure actual source lookup separately from scientific consultation and conclusions.

already_counted.description: Actual source checks, scientific consultation and final decision capture remain.

incremental.description: Maintain actual model/project source links and revision defaults.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked actual consultation decision record and internal destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 6.9 percent net, conditional on actual repeated source/context work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend preventive measures from actual monitoring evidence

steps.what: Select and reconcile actual operations-monitoring or test-result sources, equipment/time identities, units and the preventive-measure question
inputs: actual operations-monitoring/test-result exports
actual engineering question and applicable controlled assessment criteria
outputs: engineer-checked actual monitoring/test source set and identity/unit map

steps.what: Assemble the checked monitoring/test records through fixed identity/unit/time joins and supplied comparison rules, flagging missing and unmatched evidence
inputs: engineer-checked actual monitoring/test source set and identity/unit map
actual owner-approved evidence comparison rules
outputs: source-linked monitoring/test comparison table and evidence gaps

steps.what: Verify the assembled evidence, investigate gaps and recommend preventive measures for handling nuclear technology based on actual monitoring or test evaluation
inputs: source-linked monitoring/test comparison table and evidence gaps
actual original monitoring/test records and engineering context
outputs: engineer-authored actual preventive recommendations, evidence and limitations

steps.what: Prepare and correct the written recommendation wording from the engineer's actual authored measures and source-linked reasoning
inputs: engineer-authored actual preventive recommendations, evidence and limitations

loop.input: Actual engineer-authored measures, reasoning and source references
loop.output: Proposed recommendation prose retaining supplied limits and references
loop.check: Engineer checks every measure and causal statement against the authored recommendation and original evidence
loop.stop: Missing measure, unsupported claim or altered technical meaning returns to manual wording; no operating parameters or new action is proposed
loop.why_not_simpler: Variable engineering reasoning needs prose rather than fixed field filling; numeric joins are deterministic

steps.what: Check the complete final preventive recommendation, supporting evidence, limitations and exact internal engineering recipient
inputs: engineer-corrected proposed preventive recommendation document
engineer-authored actual preventive recommendations, evidence and limitations
actual internal engineering recipient
outputs: exact checked final preventive recommendation version and internal recipient

steps.what: Send only the exact checked final preventive recommendation to the actual internal engineering recipient for their subsequent review
inputs: exact checked final preventive recommendation version and internal recipient
outputs: actual preventive recommendation delivered internally, pending any implementation approval

tasks.design: Configure native source joins in {OPS_SYSTEM}, engineering monitoring/test analysis, then use bounded prose assistance in {DOCS} only for the engineer's already-authored recommendations. The engineer verifies the evidence and full final recommendation before the separate internal send; the proposal does not implement measures or control equipment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated evidence assembly and recommendation wording can surround actual preventive engineering judgment.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit native data joins and source-bound prose preparation can reduce that handling.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence quality, actual causes and the suitability of preventive measures require engineering judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a recommendation unsupported by the actual operating/test evidence.

ambition.what: Reduce evidence assembly and wording around actual engineering recommendations.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-6 with monitoring/test data owners and engineering governance

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit evidence joins and source-bound drafting can reduce recommendation preparation while preventive-measure decisions and full engineering review remain human work.

assumptions: Monitoring instruments/operators and test owners produce the actual exports; the engineer selects/checks identities and units in s1. Actual owner-approved criteria are supplied, not generated; no clean joined evidence set is assumed.

Missing keys, unit conflicts or unsupported comparisons become gaps for actual investigation in s3. The semantic step only words recommendations already authored by the engineer and cannot invent measures, parameters or test results.

Native joins/templates first. Existing equivalent assembly removes that gain; existing monitoring/calculation runtime earns no saving. Shares 20/20/35/15/9/1 are unmeasured active effort; gross saving 20 + 4.5 = 24.5 minus 3 hours of source/draft upkeep leaves 21.5 net.

This is an actual written internal recommendation, not a new report after every observation. Negligible send is fully retained. Final version and recipient are checked in s5; changes invalidate the gate.

No operating procedure update, equipment action, implementation approval or external notice is hidden in the recommendation send. Any actual implementation requires its separate existing engineering process.
unknowns: Actual manual evidence assembly and current recommendation workflow
research_questions: Measure source reconciliation and full engineering checking after replacing actual repeated joins.

already_counted.description: Actual source checks, preventive engineering judgment, prose correction and full final verification remain.

incremental.description: Maintain evidence mappings and inspect source-bound draft omissions or altered meaning.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked final preventive recommendation version and internal recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 21.5 percent net, conditional on actual repeated evidence assembly and written recommendations.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve and review the actual construction proposal revision, existing technical comments and interested parties' questions
inputs: actual construction proposal and controlled technical references
actual vendor, contractor or facility review-board questions
outputs: engineer-reviewed actual proposal sources and discussion questions

steps.what: Discuss construction project proposals with actual interested parties such as vendors, contractors or nuclear facility review boards, clarifying technical assumptions and disagreements
inputs: engineer-reviewed actual proposal sources and discussion questions
actual interested parties and their responses
outputs: actual construction-proposal discussion, clarifications and unresolved issues

tasks.design: Configure native proposal/revision links in {OPS_SYSTEM}, engineering document control, to reduce actual source navigation. The engineer discusses the real proposal with interested parties through {TELEPHONY}; no agreement, construction approval or formal written issue is inferred from discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Retrieving current proposal references can interrupt actual technical discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Native proposal/revision views can expose existing controlled sources.
tasks.still_hard: Technical interpretation, conflicting interests and actual party responses require human discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a proposal assumption that a vendor or review board has not actually accepted.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4 with proposal document control and participant access owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native engineering proposal/revision links can reduce source retrieval while actual technical discussion remains human work.

assumptions: Actual proposal owners and interested parties supply real proposals/comments/questions. The engineer checks sources in s1 and produces actual clarifications in s2; no structured agreement is assumed.
Native links first; equivalent existing navigation removes the gain. Missing revisions or disputed technical claims require manual discussion, not generated acceptance.

This statement is actual discussion, not an added meeting report or formal construction decision. No required written record/send/commit is hidden in s2; if the actual episode includes an issued clarification or formal review decision, count that actual work separately.
Shares 20/80 are provisional unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 6 minus 1 hour of link/view upkeep leaves 5 net. Discussion conveys no new construction or procurement authority.
unknowns: Actual proposal navigation and separately required formal review records
research_questions: Observe proposal retrieval separately from technical discussion and any actual formal deliverable.

already_counted.description: Actual proposal checking and interested-party discussion remain.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 5 percent net; actual technical discussion remains.

steps.what: Review the actual authorized experiment protocol and research question and check the final setup, instruments, assigned scope and current physical readiness
inputs: actual authorized study protocol concerning nuclear material usage, fuel reclamation or waste disposal
actual test equipment, instruments, assigned authority and current conditions
outputs: exact checked authorized experiment protocol/setup and current physical readiness

steps.what: Perform the actual authorized experiments that provide information about acceptable nuclear material usage, nuclear fuel reclamation or waste disposal methods
inputs: exact checked authorized experiment protocol/setup and current physical readiness
actual study materials and instruments under existing authorized procedures
outputs: actual experiment measurement export and engineer-observed conditions

steps.what: Select and verify the actual experiment export, run identity, channel/unit mapping and missing measurements
inputs: actual experiment measurement export and engineer-observed conditions
outputs: engineer-checked actual run export, unit/channel map and gaps

steps.what: Import the checked actual measurement export into the research analysis workspace through fixed run/channel/unit mappings and reject unsupported rows
inputs: engineer-checked actual run export, unit/channel map and gaps
outputs: proposed source-linked experiment analysis dataset and rejected rows

steps.what: Resolve rejected rows, verify actual measurements, analyze and interpret results, write the actual findings/limits and check the complete experiment record and destination
inputs: proposed source-linked experiment analysis dataset and rejected rows
actual experiment measurement export and engineer-observed conditions
actual authorized research question and protocol
outputs: exact checked actual experiment record, findings/limits and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked experiment record in its intended internal research revision
inputs: exact checked actual experiment record, findings/limits and internal destination

tasks.design: Configure native fixed-field import of actual existing instrument exports in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the research measurement/analysis environment. The engineer performs only the actual authorized experiment, checks every imported value and interprets/writes/verifies the real findings before saving; no experimental method or operating setting is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual research measurements may be re-keyed into an analysis workspace.
tasks.enabler_now: Native instrument-export mappings can replace actual repeated measurement entry.
tasks.still_hard: Physical experiment conduct, measurement validity and conclusions about acceptable methods remain expert work.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when an apparent result reflects setup or instrument limitations rather than the research question.

ambition.what: Remove actual measurement re-keying around authorized research.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-6 with research governance and instrument/data owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed instrument-export imports can replace repeated data entry while authorized experiment conduct, source verification and scientific interpretation remain expert work.

assumptions: This is an existing authorized instrumented study, not a new experiment design or authorization. Actual responsible research owners supply the protocol; instruments produce the export and the engineer produces observations in s2. Source selection/mapping checks are counted in s3 and rejected-row/source verification in s5.

Import requires actual run/source version, channel, unit and measured value. Missing fields, unsupported schemas or unit conflicts stop for manual handling; no free sensor, clean dataset or inferred measurement is assumed.

Native import first; equivalent existing transfer removes the gain. Existing instrument and analysis runtime earn no saving. Shares 25/45/5/10/14/1 are unmeasured active effort; gross saving 10 minus 2 hours of mapping upkeep leaves 8 net.
Changed protocol/setup or physical conditions requires renewed actual readiness in s1 before s2. Final record edits require renewed s5 checking. Negligible save remains fully retained.
The task produces actual research evidence, not an operating-method approval, material handling instruction or facility deployment. No hidden control action or external report send is proposed.
unknowns: Actual export schema, repeated measurement entry and current validated import
research_questions: Measure real data transfer and source-check effort in the authorized study environment.

already_counted.description: Actual protocol/readiness checks, physical experiment, source verification and complete scientific record remain.

incremental.description: Maintain and verify actual instrument-export mappings after source changes.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked authorized experiment protocol/setup and current physical readiness
exact checked actual experiment record, findings/limits and internal destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 8 percent net, conditional on actual measurement re-keying; all experiment and scientific interpretation work remains.
